output.question: Who owns NewsBreak?
output.answer: NewsBreak is the business name of Particle Media, Inc., a privately held Delaware corporation—not a publicly traded news company. Its disclosed investors include Francisco Partners, which currently lists NewsBreak as a minority investment, and IDG Capital, whose investment NewsBreak confirmed in January 2021. Jeff Zheng is its founder and current CEO, but that does not establish that he is its sole or controlling owner. A complete current shareholder breakdown could not be verified, so no majority owner can be reliably identified from the available disclosures. ([newsguardtech.com](https://www.newsguardtech.com/feedback/publisher/newsbreak-com/))
